Question: When you answer a question in your own words, should that answer close the other questions it covers right away, even before the agent's written note of your answer is checked?

You said on 2026-10-20: "how each kind of issue reaches me (question tool, study room, studies, debug)"

Recommended: Your own words are the authority, so an answer you have already given should not be asked again while a check is pending.); No, wait for the check (Matching questions keep coming to you until the note of your answer is checked and approved.)
